say:3:1524514001:1.text: I remember... jumping in front of a beast, and it scratched my back...
say:3:1524514001:1.source_cn: 我记得……我挡在野兽前面，然后被它抓伤了后背……

say:4:1524514002:1.text: Are the hunters safe? My injury was quite bad... I thought...
say:4:1524514002:1.source_cn: 对了，狩猎队呢，他们还好吗？还有我的伤……我记得受的伤...

say:5:1524514003:1.text: Take it slow. Your wound is still raw, so stay still.
say:5:1524514003:1.source_cn: 冷静一点，你的伤刚愈合，不能乱动。

say:6:1524514004:1.text: Thanks to your warning, the hunters responded to the ambush in time. Some were injured, but none as seriously as you.
say:6:1524514004:1.source_cn: 多亏你的提醒，狩猎队反应及时，虽然有几个人受了伤，但都...

say:7:1524514005:1.text: If you're wondering how you pulled through, you can thank this gentleman's powerful magic.
say:7:1524514005:1.source_cn: 至于你的伤为什么能恢复得这么快，这多亏了<style=...
say:7:1524514005:1.male: If you're wondering how you pulled through, you can thank this gentleman's powerful magic.
say:7:1524514005:1.female: If you're wondering how you pulled through, you can thank this lady's powerful magic.

choice_prompt:8:1524514005.text: If you're wondering how you pulled through, you can thank this gentleman's powerful magic.
choice_prompt:8:1524514005.source_cn: 至于你的伤为什么能恢复得这么快，这多亏了<style=stress><player_name></style>。凭借<male>他</male><female>她</female>高深的魔法，我们才能救回你。
choice_prompt:8:1524514005.male: If you're wondering how you pulled through, you can thank this gentleman's powerful magic.
choice_prompt:8:1524514005.female: If you're wondering how you pulled through, you can thank this lady's powerful magic.

say:9:1524514007:1.text: In our entire tribe, only this gentleman and Gala possess such power. Maybe Roli, too.
say:9:1524514007:1.source_cn: 放眼整个雅库伯尔，只有<male>他</male><f...
say:9:1524514007:1.male: In our entire tribe, only this gentleman and Gala possess such power. Maybe Roli, too.
say:9:1524514007:1.female: In our entire tribe, only this lady and Gala possess such power. Maybe Roli, too.

say:11:1524514009:1.text: I believe Roli has it in her to become as great as her masters.
say:11:1524514009:1.source_cn: 以绒利的天赋，她将来或许也可以做到。

say:12:1524514010:1.source_cn: 魔法……竟然能做到这样神奇的事。

say:13:1524514011:1.text: If there had been such powerful mages to help me back then, I might not have had to quit hunting...
say:13:1524514011:1.source_cn: 如果当初部落里也有这样多厉害的魔法师，我……或许也不会...

say:15:1524514013:1.text: Mama, I want to apologize. I... I shouldn't have rejected everything about being a warrior, and I regret the hurtful things I said to you.
say:15:1524514013:1.source_cn: 阿娘，我想和你道歉。我……我不该那么排斥战士的一切，还...

say:16:1524514014:1.text: Today, you jumped into danger to protect your peers... That was heroic!
say:16:1524514014:1.source_cn: 你今天冲出去保护其他人的事情……很勇敢，很厉害！

say:19:1524514017:1.text: ... Mama owes you an apology too, my dear.

say:20:1524514018:1.text: All this time, I've been forcing you to learn from me, and I ignored your thoughts...
say:20:1524514018:1.source_cn: 一直以来，我只想要把自己的战斗技巧都教给你，却忽略了你...

say:22:1524514020:1.text: You have extraordinary talent in magic, so being a warrior may not be the best path for you.
say:22:1524514020:1.source_cn: 你的魔法天赋那么出众，当战士未必是最好的选择。

say:23:1524514021:1.text: I won't stand in your way anymore... Do whatever your heart desires.
say:23:1524514021:1.source_cn: 我不再阻拦你……你想做什么，就去做什么吧。

say:25:1524514023:1.text: Mama, I... I'm willing to learn some warrior skills from you, but I want to focus more on studying magic.
say:25:1524514023:1.source_cn: 阿娘，我……我愿意学习一些战士的技巧，但我还是更想以学...

say:26:1524514024:1.text: I hope to save more lives in the future, just like Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> did for you.
say:26:1524514024:1.source_cn: 因为，我希望以后也能救助更多受伤的战士，就像<styl...
say:26:1524514024:1.male: I hope to save more lives in the future, just like Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> did for you.
say:26:1524514024:1.female: I hope to save more lives in the future, just like Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> did for you.

say:27:1524514025:1.text: I suppose it's also one way to uphold the "warrior's glory."
say:27:1524514025:1.source_cn: 对于雅库伯尔来说……这也是一种延续“战士的荣耀”的方法吧？

say:28:1524514026:1.text: Roli, you really think that? I'm so glad you finally got it... *Cough*
say:28:1524514026:1.source_cn: 绒利，你真的是这样想的吗？你终于明白……咳咳……

say:29:1524514027:1.text: Don't get up! Your injury hasn't fully healed yet!
say:29:1524514027:1.source_cn: 别动！你的伤还没好全，还不能起来！

say:30:1524514028:1.text: Mama, please stay in bed! We can't risk your wound reopening!
say:30:1524514028:1.source_cn: 阿娘，你先好好休息！回头伤口又裂开了怎么办？

say:31:1524514029:1.text: Come with me, I'll prepare more medicine for you.
say:31:1524514029:1.source_cn: 唉，跟我来吧，我再给你制一些药。

say:35:1524514031:1.text: ... Ah! I almost forgot Master Gala's still waiting for my reply!
say:35:1524514031:1.source_cn: ……对了，加拉老师还在等着我的回复！
say:35:1524514031:1.male: ... Ah! I almost forgot Master Gala's still waiting for my reply!
say:35:1524514031:1.female: ... Ah! I almost forgot Master Gala's still waiting for my reply!

say:36:1524514032:1.text: I have to let her know my decision. I just hope she won't be upset...
say:36:1524514032:1.source_cn: 我得赶紧把我决定同时学魔法和战士技巧的事告诉她！唔，不...

choice_prompt:37:1524514032.female: I have to let her know my decision. I just hope she won't be upset...

say:39:1524514034:1.source_cn: 那我们这就出发，去找加拉老师吧！
